verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue. The paired GUI and CLI derivations still fail closed on disagreement, the pinned nine-alias golden contract matches the real download component, and the hermetic self-test passes the real path, missing-secondary release block, five non-vacuous partial-extraction mutations, and benign quote reformat. Release staging precedes both the contract check and checksum generation. Findings are materially unchanged from round 2 (none), so progress is stagnant.
